{"claim_id": "c2", "code": "import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, "/root/cases/case_151")
import torch
from kernel import run, reference, make_inputs

Q = 3329
res = {}
for width in (64, 128):
    x, = make_inputs(device="cuda", batch=4, width=width, seed=3)
    out = run(x)
    ref = reference(x)
    # direct mismatch
    direct_mism = int((out != ref).sum())
    # inverse transform signature: out == forward transform with omega^{-j*k}?
    omega = pow(17, 256 // width, Q)
    inv = pow(omega, -1, Q)
    m = torch.tensor([[pow(inv, k * j, Q) for j in range(width)] for k in range(width)],
                     dtype=torch.int64, device=x.device)
    ref_inv = (x.to(torch.int64)[:, None, :] * m[None]).sum(2) % Q
    inv_mism = int((out.to(torch.int64) != ref_inv).sum())
    # permutation signature: does sorted row multiset match?
    perm_ok = all(torch.equal(torch.sort(out[b].to(torch.int64))[0], torch.sort(ref[b].to(torch.int64))[0]) for b in range(x.shape[0]))
    res[f"N{width}"] = {"direct_mismatch": direct_mism, "inverse_mismatch": inv_mism,
                        "row_multiset_matches_reference": bool(perm_ok)}

print(json.dumps({"metric": "exact mismatch vs forward and vs inverse DFT, plus row-multiset permutation check",
 "reason": "a conjugated/inverse twiddle mapping would match the inverse transform and preserve row multisets",
 **res}))", "expected_signal": "direct_mismatch 0 with inverse_mismatch > 0 means correct forward transform (claim rebutted); direct_mismatch > 0 and inverse_mismatch 0 confirms inverse mapping"}

import numpy as np

Q = 3329
vals = np.arange(0, 3329, dtype=np.int64)
# Build all reachable coefficient values: every residue can appear as a Montgomery coefficient? Check both the full square range and actual banks.
def multiply(v, c):
    product = v * c  # int64, max 3328*3328 ~ 1.1e7
    correction = (product * 3327) & 65535
    reduced = (product + correction * Q) >> 16
    return reduced - Q if reduced >= Q else reduced

# Exhaustive over full reachable operand grid (value in [0,3328], coefficient in [0,3328])
V = vals[:, None]
C = vals[None, :]
product = V * C
correction = (product * 3327) & 65535
reduced = (product + correction * Q) >> 16
out = np.where(reduced >= Q, reduced - Q, reduced)
expected = (V * C * pow(1 << 16, -1, Q)) % Q  # value * coeff in Montgomery form -> value*omega mod Q
wrong_residue = int((out != expected).sum())
out_of_range = int(((out < 0) | (out > 3328)).sum())
reduced_max = int(reduced.max())
out = out.astype(np.int64)

print(json.dumps({"metric": "exhaustive count of wrong residues and out-of-range results over all 3329x3329 reachable operand pairs",
 "reason": "tol-0 exactness; _multiply must return (value*coefficient*R^-1) mod Q = value*omega mod Q in [0,3328] for every pair",
 "wrong_residue_count": wrong_residue, "out_of_range_count": out_of_range,
 "pairs_checked": 3329 * 3329, "max_reduced_before_subtract": reduced_max}))", "expected_signal": "wrong_residue_count==0 and out_of_range_count==0 over all 11085641 pairs refutes the claim; any nonzero count confirms it"}
